changes: 🎰 Live Blackjack is now actually playable, not just seating. Set a bet on your own seat with a real chip rail, tap Deal once anyone's got a bet staged (yourself included — solo works, nobody else required). Dealer shows a real up-card with the hole card genuinely face-down (not just hidden by CSS — the actual card data isn't sent to your device until it's revealed). Your own hand shows real cards and a live total, your seat gets a visible highlight when it's your turn, and Hit/Stand/Double appear only then — Double only offered when it's actually legal to use.
After a hand settles, a results panel shows who won, lost, or pushed and by how much, staying visible until the next bet gets placed.

Reuses the exact same card rendering the single-player Blackjack table already uses (same visual cards, same styling) via a small format conversion, rather than building a second card-drawing system from scratch.
